name: Harness check on any single-GPU instance: one tiny gdsio cell per mode and one KvikIO read, on /local

tasks.name: gdsio_sweep.py, 1 GPU, 1 thread, 1 MiB, 5 s per mode
commands: mkdir -p /local/gdsio-smoke && [ -f /local/gdsio-smoke/f0 ] || dd if=/dev/urandom of=/local/gdsio-smoke/f0 bs=16M count=64 oflag=direct status=none

tasks.name: kvikio_read.py, 1 GPU, compat on and off
commands: for M in on off; do CUFILE_ENV_PATH_JSON=$OUT/cufile/default.json $VENV/bin/python $INVESTIGATION_DIR/scripts/kvikio_read.py --label smoke --dir /local/gdsio-smoke --out $OUT/smoke --gpus 1 --threads 4 --compat $M || true; done
